note: Local, non-commercial research and model training only. Puzzle data stays in references/ (gitignored) or the private bucket; never published. Every converted puzzle carries source, sourceId, licence and author.

sources.name: puzzlekit-dataset
sources.licence: none on the dataset (puzzlekit's code is MIT); each puzzle's rights follow its origin
sources.verdict: go with care (as an index); only its janko.at puzzles converted in phase 1
sources.fetch: one release archive of commit 719109eebf3cf84d5c94e8381588891a046a3abd (2026-09-22) from codeload.github.com

counts.leftOut: origins other than janko.at: the puzzle-*.com sites and records with no source (see summary.json)

sources.name: SakanaAI/sudoku-bench-nikoli (nikoli_100)
sources.fetch: the parquet file and README at revision 9034906b4ec06ab1e08daf110c6b562ef72859fd, and the same rows from Hugging Face's dataset viewer API

sources.name: Janko (www.janko.at/Raetsel/), every type
sources.licence: per puzzle, its page's Lizenz: Creative Commons 3.0 BY-NC-SA (go), or the author's permission, Freeware or none stated (go with care)

crawl.tool: puzzles/difficulty/sources/janko_crawl.py (own fetcher; robots.txt blocks site copiers)
crawl.stopsOn: HTTP errors other than 404 (a 5xx after one retry a minute later), 429s, network errors; 20 missing pages in a row

sources.name: Puzzle Square JP, public puzzles
sources.licence: guideline: rights stay with each poster; no reposting; no load on the system. Its CC0 example puzzles are free to use

crawl.endpoint: /api/problem/date/<day> (public, no login): a day's puzzles with their puzz.link, pzprxs or Penpa link
crawl.stopsOn: HTTP errors other than 404 (a 5xx after one retry a minute later), 429s, network errors

sources.name: puzz.link's database (pzvs_anon, gmpuzzles_anon)
sources.licence: none; puzz.link: copyright "lies with their authors", the database "only shares puzzles that are available publicly"

crawl.endpoint: /db/api/pzvs_anon and /db/api/gmpuzzles_anon (public PostgREST), keyset pages of 5,000 on sort_key
crawl.stopsOn: HTTP errors other than 404 (a 5xx after one retry a minute later), 429s, network errors
crawl.robots: read every run (Cloudflare's content-signal template, no signals set)
crawl.never: the per-solve tables (pzv_solves_anon, griddle_solves_anon: 401) and anything needing a login

sources.name: Logic Masters India, Puzzle Expo (per-puzzle figures)
sources.licence: none found; "any puzzle published on LMI Puzzle Expo is, and remains, the intellectual property of the author"
sources.verdict: go with care for per-puzzle aggregates; per-solver timings and replays never collected

crawl.endpoint: POST /live/misc-pp?action=apply-filters (the search table, 100 a request) and action=get-puzzle (one puzzle's page), logged out
crawl.cache: every response, gzipped, cut to the kept fields before it's written (comments and profiles never stored)
crawl.stopsOn: HTTP errors other than 404 (a 5xx after one retry a minute later), 429s, network errors
crawl.login: never; the Penpa puzzle data (action=pqr) needs one, so puzzles convert only through a post we already hold
